title: Slabs to Blocks: Minecraft
description: A mod that gives preconfigured crafting recipes for turning Minecraft's slabs into blocks.
body:
This preconfigured mod lets you craft your unused slabs back into their block variants, allowing you to not go through any config tabs to make the recipes yourself! All you need to do is simply place two slabs on top of each other in the crafting table!

![Oak slabs being turned back into a block varient](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0552eeda4c4bd85eec68822440bc4548bf9ffcd3.png)
